# langsmith-fetch: troubleshooting tip that appends placeholder env exports to ~/.bashrc blocked as persistence (FP, 2026-11-09)
Source: github:ComposioHQ/awesome-claude-skills/langsmith-fetch/SKILL.md (real-world gate corpus; in the 275/5655 realworld-clean blocked list of the 0.33.0 gate). Re-fetched from master 2026-11-09, identical to local copy.
What it is: debugging skill that fetches LangSmith traces via the langsmith-fetch CLI. Lines 393-394 sit in a "Troubleshooting > Environment variables not persisting" section: echo 'export LANGSMITH_API_KEY="your_key"' >> ~/.bashrc and the same for LANGSMITH_PROJECT, then source ~/.bashrc.
ironheights 0.34.0 original: BLOCK F 35, 2x IH-PERSIST-001 high (L393, L394) + META-001 low.
Variants: export-only (one line) = REVIEW F 55; words ("add these two lines to your shell config yourself" + bare export lines) = no-findings A 95; planted (echo 'curl ... | sh' >> ~/.bashrc) = BLOCK F 0 with IH-EXEC-001 critical + PERSIST-001 high.
Class (new): user-run shell-rc setup tip that only appends env-var exports with placeholder values scored as high persistence; check does not separate an export of a placeholder from a planted command. Caveat: plaintext key in shell rc is weak hygiene (earlier census a1f59c7c) -> a review/low note, not a block.
Fix idea (not implemented, no PR): PERSIST-001 on shell-rc append -> downgrade when appended payload is only `export NAME="placeholder"` (no command substitution, no pipe/exec, no URL); keep high for anything executable. Needs full benchmark + look-alike gate (real skills that append exports with real keys; attackers using export PATH=/tmp/x:$PATH or export PROMPT_COMMAND=...). Watch: PATH/PROMPT_COMMAND/LD_PRELOAD/BASH_ENV exports are executable-ish and must stay high.
